papers.title: GigaBrain-0.7: Scaling Embodied Foundation Models to Emergent Capabilities with a Three-System Architecture
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models demonstrate strong complex and long-horizon task completion in structured settings. GigaBrain-0.7 unifies understanding, prediction, and action through a three-system architecture, scales pretraining to over 37,000 hours of heterogeneous embodied data.

papers.title: Annotations as Rollouts: Efficient and Scalable Reinforcement Learning for Video MLLMs
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become prevalent for unified video perception. Post-training on large multi-task datasets remains challenging, as existing reinforcement learning methods sample on-policy groups with few high-quality rollouts even with costly chain-of-thought generation.

papers.title: WeMM-Embedding: WeChat Multi-Modal Embedding Technical Report
papers.abstract: Universal multimodal embeddings enable heterogeneous content representation in a shared space for applications such as retrieval, recommendation, classification, and agentic systems. WeMM-Embedding supports text, images, videos, visual documents, and interleaved multimodal inputs.

papers.title: SecOPD: Mitigating Adaptive Prompt Injections by On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: Prompt injection threatens AI agents. Defenders train secure LLMs, but these suffer near 100% attack success rates against adaptive prompt injections. SecOPD provides token-level feedback to guide defensive fine-tuning, achieving significantly lower attack success rates.

papers.title: CyberFactory: Scaling Cyber Security Capabilities with Instances from the Wild
papers.abstract: Large language models advance in coding capabilities with potential for cybersecurity applications. CyberFactory connects data construction, trajectory synthesis, and model training across proof-of-concept generation, vulnerability patching, and cybersecurity question answering.

papers.title: Game2World Engine: Unlocking In-the-Wild Gameplay Videos for World Model Training
papers.abstract: Video games provide scalable training data for video world models. Raw gameplay footage entangles the game world with screen-space interfaces. G2WEngine automatically extracts reusable UI assets and synthesizes temporally coherent UI overlays on clean footage.

papers.title: From Seeing to Acting: Smart Glasses as First-Person Intelligence Platforms
papers.abstract: Smart glasses evolve from capture and display accessories into first-person intelligence platforms connecting human perception, persistent context, and digital or physical action. They must operate under tight energy, thermal, privacy, and feedback constraints.

papers.title: AgentRoom: Concurrent Multi-Agent Coding in a CRDT-Backed Shared Workspace
papers.abstract: Concurrent multi-agent coding promises division of labor across modules and robustness through redundancy. AgentRoom is a realtime collaborative editing protocol for concurrent coding agents using Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs) on a shared filesystem.

papers.title: Automata from Agent Traces: Failure and Next-Step Prediction
papers.abstract: LLM-based agents execute multi-step tasks, but their behavioral structure remains opaque. This work collapses entire trace corpora into single, compact finite-state machines serving as structural substrates for otherwise unpredictable LLM agent behavior.

papers.title: DREAM Technical Report
papers.abstract: Industrial recommender systems use cascaded retrieval, ranking, and re-ranking pipelines. DREAM adds a perception-aware, orchestrable, and auditable policy layer atop existing pipelines without replacing them through an Intent Engine and Meta Engine.

cc_updates.body: Added a startup warning for Bash allow rules with a wildcard before the subcommand (e.g. `Bash(git * main)`), since they also match options inserted before the subcommand. Added an Auto mode tab to `/permissions` for viewing and editing auto mode classifier rules. Added the turn's completion time to the end-of-turn duration line, e.g. `✻ Sautéed for 23s · done 6:05 PM`. Fixed fullscreen mode showing a blank transcript after resizing the terminal and jumping to the bottom until the next keypress. Fixed a severe transcript slowdown when a diff contained a very long single line (e.g. a base64 string); such lines now render truncated with a marker. Fixed erratic fullscreen scrolling when positioned at an earlier message, including jump-to-bottom getting stuck mid-transcript.
Fixed a crash on startup on Linux distributions that ship glibc 2.44 (for example Arch Linux, CachyOS and Fedora Rawhide)
